title: Pisgah Forest Stables
specs: Trails include overlooks and old chimney on longer rides
Good for ages 9 and up for 2 hour ride, ages 12 and up and some riding experience preferred for 2.5 hour ride, under 7 for pony rides
blurb: Guests ride horses on guided trail rides ranging from 10 minutes for pony rides to 2.5 hours for mountaintop rides. Trails vary in length and difficulty, with some rides offering overlooks and requiring some riding experience. Pony rides are for children under 7 and are led on a lead rope.
extraNote: Reservations recommended but not required; rides times may vary during slow season · All reservations held with debit or credit card; no charge until ride time; cash or check preferred · Cancellation policy: 24 hours for 1 hour ride, 48 hours for 2 or 2.5 hour rides · Pisgah Forest Stables, 2 miles into Pisgah National Forest on Hwy 276, first right past Ranger Station (sign posted).
